name: opcheese-skills
description: Our agent skills: the Superpowers fork (human and unattended spines), codebase-design vocabulary, and the shadow learning memory store

plugins.name: superpowers-human
plugins.description: Superpowers fork, interactive spine: human-in-the-loop gates, per-task native code-review checkpoint, end-of-run sign-off

plugins.name: superpowers-agents
plugins.description: Superpowers fork, unattended spine: rulings over stalls, automated verification gate, escalation, always-PR. For claude -p in CI, cron and pipelines

plugins.name: codebase-vocabulary
plugins.description: Design vocabulary and procedures that work on either spine: deep modules and seams, and merge-conflict resolution

plugins.name: codebase-vocabulary-human
plugins.description: Interactive-only companions to codebase-vocabulary: domain glossary and ADR discipline, and a setup skill that installs hooks blocking dangerous git commands. Both need a person at the keyboard

plugins.name: shadow-learn-memory
plugins.description: Shadow learning memory store: extract durable knowledge from your Claude Code, Codex and Kimi sessions, consolidate it into patterns and entities, and scaffold long-horizon research threads. Every write is gated on your confirmation

plugins.name: kimi-delegation
plugins.description: Delegate work to Kimi from Claude Code: read-only review and bulk tasks through Kimi's own agents, or Claude Code itself running on Kimi's model. Needs either a Kimi API key or a Kimi Code subscription with CLI >= 0.38.0
